title: Lentils and kielbasa
ingredients: 1 onion, carrot, and celery stalk, chopped
1 1/2 cups brown or green lentils, rinsed
steps: Brown kielbasa; set aside. Cook vegetables in the pot until soft.
Add garlic, lentils, broth, bay, and thyme. Simmer until lentils are tender, 25–30 minutes.
Return sausage. Season with salt, pepper, a splash of vinegar, and mustard at the table.
